name: Pension Kristall
beschreibung:
History

The website pension-kristall.com names the house a newly opened apartment house and at the same time the Pension Kristall. For the winter season 2025/26 it is to be completely renovated and reopened with modern rooms, a new breakfast area and offers for families and winter-sports guests. Both sentences stand on the same page retrieved. An older founding year before this renovation is not given. As operator it says KRISTALL APARTMENTS, Familie Matthias Siller, Stubaitalstraße 102, 6167 Neustift, telephone +43 5226 2746, email info@pension-kristall.com. Further down on the same page, for the Pension Kristall, telephone +43 5226 2354 and fax +43 5226 2345-5 are additionally given, the same email and the same street. The two telephone numbers are not merged. The location is central in Neustift, one to two minutes on foot to restaurants, cafés, shops and a pharmacy. There is a sauna and a rest room with a view towards the Serles. Direct booking via the website is advertised as the best price without hidden fees, also at short notice.

Getting there

The address is Stubaitalstraße 102, 6167 Neustift im Stubaital. A bus-timetable table of the house’s own is missing. The page describes the Stubai Super Card for stays at a participating partner business, valid according to the body text from the beginning of May to the end of October, and elsewhere from 23 May to 29 October. Included are one mountain ride and one valley ride per day without ski equipment on the Stubaier Gletscherbahn, the Serlesbahnen, the Bergbahnen Schlick 2000 and the Elferbahnen in Neustift, plus free travel on the buses of the Innsbrucker Verkehrsbetriebe between Mutterberg and Innsbruck and free travel on the Stubaitalbahn Fulpmes–Innsbruck–Fulpmes. Whether the pension is a participating partner on every day of the season stands as a condition on the page and should be confirmed when booking. The two date windows of the card contradict each other on the same website and are therefore both named.

Tips

The apartments: TOP1 about 45 square metres for 1 to 3 people, TOP2 about 40 square metres for 1 to 3, TOP9 about 35 square metres for 1 to 3, TOP8 about 40 square metres for 1 to 3, TOP3, TOP4, TOP5 and TOP6 each about 85 square metres for 2 to 6 people, TOP7 about 71 square metres for 2 to 6 people. The page names four ski areas of the surroundings: Stubaier Gletscher, Schlick 2000, Serlesbahnen and Elferlifte. Those are area names on the valley side, not lifts of the house’s own. Bonus benefits of the Stubai Super Card, as the page lists them: 30 percent on the hut taxi from Neustift to the Oberissalm and from Telfes to the Pfarrachalm, on the Greifvogelpark Telfes, on additional rides of the summer toboggan run Mieders, on the Krippenmuseum Fulpmes, on entry to the Bergiselstadion including the inclined lift and the tower lift and on the combined ticket of the Innsbrucker Landesmuseen. Also, in the inclusive part: two entries per week for three hours at the Erlebnisbad StuBay, the Miederer Schwimmbad and one ride per week on the summer toboggan run Mieders. Prices for the apartments themselves are not on the page retrieved as a table.
kurzbeschreibung: Kristall Apartments of the family Matthias Siller, Stubaitalstraße 102 in Neustift, described as a newly opened apartment house with a sauna, renovated for the winter season 2025/26.
